    1. abandon()

Interface RouteLocator.AbandonableStage

Enclosing class:
RouteLocator
@Internal public static interface RouteLocator.AbandonableStage
The stage of an asynchronous locator that belongs to one request, e.g. of a locator that reads the body of the request: unlike a stage a locator may share with other requests, it is abandoned when the request is, see RouteLocator.abandonPendingLocations(HttpRequest), so that it releases what it holds of the request, while the stages it waits for, which may be shared, keep running.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
